BiblicalUsage: Once in three years the navy of Tharshish comes, bringing gold and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks. The word is the monkey itself, carried home with the treasure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the apes in Solomon's ships are the reminder that his glory reached the ends of the earth, and it was all gift.
